---
title: "China's Trade Dynamics in 2021-2023"
description: "China's exports peaked in 2022 before falling in 2023, with trade reorienting away from the US and Taiwan and toward Russia and Brazil."
date: "2024-01-22"
categories: [trade-wars, china]
---

China's trade over 2021–2023 shows a clear geopolitical fingerprint: exports
peaked at $3.54 trillion in 2022 before falling 3.46% in 2023, while imports
fell more sharply, down 5.24% — a pattern read here as a reorientation of
trade strategy rather than simple cyclical weakness. Traditional partners,
the US and Taiwan among them, saw significant declines, while trade with
Russia and Brazil grew substantially, tracking the realignments driven by the
war in Ukraine, Middle East conflict, and shifting political alliances more
broadly.
